pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.intro: Two-way air-freight rate policy, effective from 1 October 2026.

vnJp.intro: Prices include tax and Japan domestic delivery — the customer simply receives the goods at the address. Consolidation and packing are free.

clean.title: Clean goods
clean.desc: Fashion, household items, furniture, machinery, accessories, books… We do not accept food, cosmetics, medicine, or counterfeit goods. Goods are 100% guaranteed. Wholesale perk: this month's volume sets next month's rate.
clean.note: Surcharge of 200,000 VND/parcel. Price includes Japan domestic delivery.

mixed.title: Mixed goods
mixed.desc: A wide range accepted: clothing, footwear, food… Not guaranteed for meat products, counterfeits, seeds, fruit, cosmetics, or medicine. Prohibited: narcotics, stimulants, weapons, ammunition…

vnJp.rounding: Weight rounding — Clean goods: to the nearest 0.5 kg (e.g. 3.2 kg → 3.5 kg). Mixed goods: under 0.1 kg rounds down, over 0.1 kg rounds up (e.g. 3.09 kg → 3 kg; 3.1 kg → 4 kg).

freight.buyRate: Buy-for-you exchange rate: VCB + 5, no surcharge.
freight.domestic: Domestic Vietnam delivery is paid by the customer, who chooses the carrier (our warehouse staff can help book it).

rows.item: Electronics and items with batteries (Starlink, used laptops, used phones, cameras…)

policy.title: Policy & services
policy.intro: How HARUTO Express calculates weight, handles compensation, and runs its buy-for-you, bid-for-you, and ship-for-you services.

standard.title: Standard goods
standard.body: Charged by the actual weighed kilograms.

bulky.title: Bulky goods
bulky.body: Counted as bulky when length + width + height exceeds 140 cm or the weight is over 30 kg (e.g. bicycles, suitcases, speakers, wedding-dress or suit boxes). Volumetric weight = (Length × Width × Height) ÷ 6,000 (cm). The freight uses the greater of actual and volumetric weight.

rounding.title: Rounding rules
rounding.body: Under 1 kg rounds up to 1 kg. Over 1 kg rounds to one decimal place (e.g. 3.04 kg → 3 kg; 3.05 kg → 3.1 kg).

insured.title: With cargo insurance
insured.body: 100% of the declared value is compensated. Insurance fee: 8% of the declared value.

uninsured.title: Without cargo insurance
uninsured.body: 100% of the shipping value is compensated, capped at 3,000,000 VND per order.

buy.title: Buy for you
buy.body: The customer pays 100% of the product value.

auction.title: Bid for you
auction.body: A 50% deposit is placed before bidding. If the bid wins, the customer pays the balance for HARUTO to settle. If it loses, HARUTO refunds 100% of the deposit.

tips.title: Important notes when shipping
items: Declare the value, quantity, and item details accurately.
If bought at a supermarket, keep the receipt (bill) and include it inside the package.
Goods sent to the warehouse must include the recipient's full details: name, phone number, and address.
When receiving goods, record one continuous video of the unboxing as evidence for any claim. Claims without a video, or raised more than 24 hours after receipt, cannot be resolved.
We do not cover goods with a shelf life of under 10 days.
If you are not home, HARUTO will reschedule the delivery. Delivery times may change due to weather, natural disasters, or customs clearance in either country.

items.question: How are shipping rates calculated?
items.answer: Rates use the greater of actual and volumetric weight (Length × Width × Height ÷ 6,000). Vietnam → Japan is priced by weight band, with separate tables for clean and mixed goods; Japan → Vietnam is 155,000 VND/kg. See the Pricing section for the full tables and surcharges.
